title: Classify span-four words with dirty auxiliary registers.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Partial classification in the abelian rank-one register model with any number of dirty auxiliary scalar registers. For three invertible 3×3 data targets and rational frame span exactly 4:

- Full support of the normalized generator needs at least nine calls.
- A zero coordinate forces block sizes 1+1+1 or 1+2.
- The 1+1+1 partition needs at least nine calls.
- The 1+2 partition needs at least eight calls. The only remaining eight-call shape is three calls on the 1×1 block and five calls on the 2×2 block, with projected 2×2 frame span exactly 3 and no strictly upper call.
- Every span-four word shorter than eight calls is impossible.

This does not prove that eight calls are impossible. Spans 5 and 6 remain open. There is no scalar saving, no paid-profile change, and no κ change. Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

Base `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`. Task `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 6. Scope status: refined. The card allows a larger register count. The alphabet stays abelian rank-one, and the question is narrowed to span 4 because the dirty-auxiliary lemmas already exclude spans at most 3 and at least 7 at eight calls.

Cited, not re-proved:

- `research/bit-dirty-auxiliary-registers` Lemmas 1 and 2, any register count
- `research/bit-three-register-lower-bound` §3 span-four normalization
- `research/three-register-no-target-flag` §6, whose six-call 2×2 step is stated only for exactly three scalar registers

Nearest open work is PR #3537, which prices nine coordinate projectors beside one idle dirty auxiliary and leaves general spans 4, 5 and 6 open. This package classifies general span 4 for any number of dirty auxiliaries and does not rerun that projector search.

A span-four eight-call word would be a completed saving against the nine-call column construction in this model. The remaining route is one five-call 2×2 word of span 3, and no such word is constructed here.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-span4-auxiliary-structure/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-span4-auxiliary-structure --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-span4-auxiliary-structure
```

Observed on this branch:

- `PASS_SPAN4_AUXILIARY_STRUCTURE`
- `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bit-span4-auxiliary-structure outcome=partial`

The same verifier was run with `python3 -O`. The checks raise exceptions, so optimization does not skip them.

The finite checks are polynomial identities, all 28 and 120 idempotent pairs at register counts 3 and 4, all 64 support patterns, the call-budget arithmetic, a nine-call restored-auxiliary word, deletion and mutation failures, and a cancelling-pair control. They are not a proof-assistant formalization, and they do not re-prove Lemmas 1 and 2.

Not run: a `120^5` search, the three-register census, and the native dirty-auxiliary engine.

## Credit

Ali Romman, PR #468 and `research/bit-three-register-lower-bound`. Dirty-auxiliary lemmas: `research/bit-dirty-auxiliary-registers` (waynenilsen; PR #468 lineage, eumemic PR #288, huxint PR #203). David Govea, `research/three-register-no-target-flag`. Open PR #3537 covers the coordinate-projector case.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. New work is Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

Linked from `research/bit-span4-auxiliary-structure/README.md`.

1. Does a five-call word exist for three invertible 2×2 targets, frame span exactly 3, and at least one dirty auxiliary? That is the only remaining eight-call span-four route. The first step is an arbitrary-register disjoint-subset argument at relation rank 2. It is blocked here by `120^5` ordered words, and a degree-1 tensor balance does not forbid five calls.
2. Can eight calls reach three invertible 3×3 targets with dirty auxiliaries when the frame span has dimension 5 or 6? The same two-relation analysis is the first step, and the same projector-count growth is the blocker.

## Workflow feedback

The package generator's pinned inputs, and the explicit limit of the three-register span-four sentence to exactly three scalar registers, made the scope cut clear. Feedback discussion: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
